## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle commentary on the *[Wú liàng shòu jīng T0360](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0060)* is by [慧遠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E9%81%A0) *Jìngyǐng Huìyuǎn* (the Suí *Dìlùn*-school master, 523–592). One of the foundational Pure-Land commentaries in the Chinese tradition, it provided the Yogācāra-influenced doctrinal-interpretive framework that would be elaborated by later Pure-Land masters [曇鸞](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%87%E9%B8%9E) Tánluán, [道綽](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E7%B6%BD) Dàochuò, and [善導](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E5%B0%8E) Shàndǎo.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (580 – 592) reflects [慧遠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E9%81%A0) *Jìngyǐng Huìyuǎn*'s mature Suí period.

The Taishō text (T1745) is established on the standard apparatus.
